title: ASMR Blue Mummy (F4TM)
description: Wrapped and bound, bondage tape being wrapped over and over, your entire body made immobile. "Pink Mummy" was originally a commission from a very supportive fan, whose girlfriend just loves to play with and use triggers from my files on her. It was so good I made not just one generic version, but a whole bunch so all my subby loves can enjoy, no matter what their gender. Trans versions only differ from cis versions, in that they recognize you might not start off with the body parts you end up with- not mentioned so much what is there as what you want there, feel should be there. Breasts flattening into pecs and so on. This is the extra ASMR version of the file.
author: Mistress Shibby
